text:
Maya: Quick sync — need to lock launch criteria for ACME on-prem pilot. Product wants feature parity but infra/security need guardrails. TL;DR: we need decisions on required HSM, prewarm, and acceptable latency SLO before we commit scope. @Jordan @Sam @Priya
Jordan: Got it. Can you list the must-have vs nice-to-have? Also which runtime changes are required? I need to know KV cache persistence reqs.
Maya: Must-have: 1) KMS/HSM integration (customer mandate), 2) RBAC + audit logs, 3) private model pinning for reproducibility. Nice-to-have: cold-start warmers, adaptive batch tuning. Product is flexible on adaptive batch if it adds >4w timeline.
Sam: From infra/runtime: HSM + KMS adds 2wk infra work (keys, rotation), HSM certs + test harness another week. Prewarm: we can do a simple reserved pool (dedicated) in 1w; auto-burst prewarm more complex. KV cache persistence to disk will change startup behavior — we'll need a migration plan.
Priya: Security signoff. HSM integration forces us to run a full Threat Model + HSM SOC checklist. We need customer questionnaire answered before developer access. That usually takes 5 business days. Also need to confirm PII handling for logs.
Alex: For rollout, propose: canary (5% traffic) for 48h, observe latency/cost/regressions, then 25% for 24h, then full. If any SLI breaches, auto-fallback to hosted model variant. Do we have fallback model variants approved?
Maya: Not yet. Product will accept fallback to a slightly smaller model with identical API shape. Will coordinate with ModelOps to produce variant.
Jordan: Action items for runtime: - list exact kernel/quantization changes - define KV cache persistence behavior - add fallback route in routing policy. I can take the routing policy change if someone owns the fallback variant.
Sam: I can own the dedicated pool + prewarm config. Quick config draft: ```yaml
reserved_pool: acme_pilot
min_gpus: 2
prewarm_policy: on_schedule
burst_policy: manual_approval
```
Priya: I'll start the security questionnaire today. Also flag: HSM endpoints must be on private network; add that to infra checklist.
InfraBot: Capacity check: reserved_pool 'acme_pilot' would consume 2x A100 for the pilot window (2024-07-15 -> 2024-08-15). No conflicts currently. :white_check_mark: 
Alex: Can we get a target latency SLO? Product suggests p95 < 350ms for typical 512-token requests.
Jordan: p95 < 350ms is tight with disk-backed KV cache. If we do warm pool + in-memory cache we can hit it. Need commit on warm pool size.
Maya: Product commits to 2x A100 reserved for pilot, and quick cost trade-offs doc. Also need checklist before launch: - security signoff - infra prewarm deployed - fallback model ready - canary routing + monitor dashboards - runbook for rollback
Sam: I'll draft the runbook and add an emergency fallback command: `redwood route set --route acme --model fallback-v1`
Priya: Noted. I'll add security acceptance criteria to the checklist and ping Compliance.
Jordan: I'll schedule a short runtime/ops working session Tue 9am to triage the kernel/kv changes.
Maya: Great. Let's reconvene after security questionnaire is done and InfraBot confirms reserved pool. Thanks all :raised_hands:
